title: Warm GP: when does it stop shrinking?
topic: Bench data on how long heated gutta-percha keeps shrinking: minutes while cooling, up to 10 h at 37 °C, no data found past 24 h.

claims.claim: Cooling: 1.0–2.3 % linear shrinkage (brand means 0.96–2.31 %) in 10 min, 75→37 °C, in vitro (3 backfill GP brands, tabletop device); also printed on the chart as '1.0–2.3% linear'
claims.source: Lottanti S, Tauböck TT, Zehnder M, J Endod 2014;40:721-4 (PMID 24767571; abstract)

claims.claim: Held at 37 °C: keeps shrinking for 45 min–10 h (time to stabilize, range across 4 thermosensitive GP products; GP first heated to 80 °C in a dilatometer; clock start not defined in the abstract), in vitro
claims.source: Lee CQ, Chang Y, Cobb CM, Robinson S, Hellmuth EM, J Endod 1997;23:579-82 (PMID 9587286; abstract)

claims.claim: Stamp 'CRYSTALLIZING?' = inferred mechanism (hence the question mark); crystallization probably starts during cooling and continues at 37 °C; Lee's abstract names no mechanism
claims.source: Inferred from Grassi MD et al., J Endod 1989;15:517-21 (PMID 2639948; abstract: isothermal shrinkage during crystallization) and Schilder H, Goodman A, Aldrich W, Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol 1985;59:285-96 (PMID 3856822; abstract)

claims.claim: Then stable to 24 h (stamp STABLE; end of the 24-h hold), in vitro, one study; Goodman's thesis abstract instead describes contraction continuing over a 24-h hold
claims.source: Lee CQ et al., J Endod 1997;23:579-82 (PMID 9587286; abstract). Contrast: Goodman AS, MScD thesis, Boston University 1973 (thesis abstract; data behind Schilder 1985, PMID 3856822)

claims.claim: After 24 h: stamp NO DATA FOUND, ruler 'days ?', stopwatch reads '>24 h' (no volume data found for heated GP)
claims.source: Literature search of PubMed abstracts, no study found (RESEARCH.md L4); not a claim that it was never measured. Wong M, Peters DD, Lorton L, J Endod 1981;7:551-8 (PMID 6985547) has no abstract and was not read. Indirect long-term data point to expansion: Wu 2000 (PMID 11307452; abstract), Michaud RA et al., J Endod 2008;34:1528-32 (PMID 19026888; abstract)

claims.claim: Compact it warm (in vitro): warm vertical compaction (Schilder technique) more than compensated for shrinkage on cooling; not tested against the hours-long tail
claims.source: Marlin J, MSD thesis, Boston University 1971 (thesis abstract only; probably published as Marlin J, Schilder H, Oral Surg Oral Med Oral Pathol 1973;36:872-9, PMID 4524837, paper not read)

claims.claim: Use sealer (in vitro): the seal of injected thermoplasticized GP was enhanced by a sealer (dye penetration)
claims.source: Bradshaw GB, Hall A, Edmunds DH, Int Endod J 1989;22:17-20 (PMID 2599657; abstract)

claims.claim: Curves, temperature trace, time axis and canal views are schematic (legend: SCHEMATIC CURVES · 2 BENCH STUDIES (IN VITRO); cards: 'NO-SEALER CANAL · SCHEMATIC', 'gap exaggerated', 'illustration')
claims.source: Toy model / schematic: curve shapes and the split between phases are drawn, not measured; the time axis is a composite of two bench experiments; no y-scale; the canal views are illustrations (no cited study measured a wall gap)

caption:
Warm gutta-percha: when does it stop shrinking?

Cooling 75→37 °C: 1.0–2.3% linear shrinkage in 10 min. At 37 °C: 45 min–10 h more by product, then stable to 24 h; Goodman's thesis (Schilder 1985): contraction through 24 h. Past 24 h: no volume data found; indirect data hint at expansion.
Bench data on free GP; crystallization inferred. In vitro, warm vertical compaction offset cooling shrinkage; injected GP sealed better with sealer. Neither covers the late tail.

Refs: Lottanti 2014, Lee 1997, Grassi 1989, J Endod; Schilder 1985, OOO; Marlin 1971 BU thesis; Bradshaw 1989, Wu 2000, Int Endod J
Schematic animation: no wall gap measured.
